## Carry On Bug Fix 1.1.0

For Minecraft 26.1.2 (NeoForge).

- Optional compatibility with Carry On Extend. Throwing a carried group with Shift+Q keeps every passenger on the vehicle.
- Throw power only changes speed. It does not remove passengers.
- If Carry On Extend is not installed, carrying behavior is unchanged.

---

## Carry On Bug Fix 1.1.0

适用于 Minecraft 26.1.2（NeoForge）。

- 可选兼容 Carry On Extend。用 Shift+Q 扔出一整组时，乘客会留在载具上。
- 投掷力度只改变速度，不会把乘客丢掉。
- 未安装 Carry On Extend 时，搬运行为不变。
